text:
Most visitors eat in Dotonbori and stop there.
One stop from Osaka Station, the city eats on a 2.6 km covered street 👇

🍣 Harukoma is the oldest sushi shop there.
Plates from around ¥100.
Closed Tuesdays. Mid-afternoon is calmest.

🥔 Butchers fry croquettes at the counter.
That's the walking snack here.

🍻 After six, standing bars fill the lanes.
One drink, two plates, then the next bar.

👉 The ordering trick at Harukoma, plus the route:
https://japanbystation.com/tenma-tenjinbashisuji-local-guide

Sushi first, or the standing bars?
